description: The best-documented phone-priced market: a 45-mile move quotes across a 5.6x spread ($1,158-$6,506). Included as the SECOND vertical to prove the system is config, not code — no agent changes vs. wedding-dress.json.

specFields.prompt: What ZIP are you moving from?
What ZIP are you moving to?
Any large or special items (piano, safe, treadmill, appliances)?
Stairs, elevator, or long carry at either end?
Do you need packing services or supplies?

priceBenchmark.note: Replace with a live benchmark feed for production.

redFlags.message: 30%+ below competition is the classic lowball-then-upcharge signal — treat as a warning, not the best deal.
Estimate given without seeing the shipment is 40% more likely to end above the quote (FMCSA). Push for a binding or not-to-exceed quote.
Large upfront deposit is a hostage-load risk — flag it.

counterpartyStyles.description: Firm on rate, wants a deposit to hold the date.
'We need an in-home survey first' — extract a per-hour rate and crew size.
Adds fuel surcharge, stairs fee, long-carry fee, packing materials. Agent itemizes and challenges each.

disclosure: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer planning a move. Just so you know, I'm an AI — I'm gathering a few quotes. Do you have a minute for some quick details?
